svg.title: The tree reader keeps every child-to-parent ratio as an independent positive geometric datum. It introduces no lower ratio bound, permits zero and one child, and retains the fixed root output outside the nonroot error sum. The tested root remainder is lifted by α, so its norm and all vacuum/character evaluations recover (NE3). The engineering identity behind this recovery is the exact finite path interchange X v Wv∆v = X l wl X v on the internal path to l ∆v = X l wlaparent(l).
